en: What brings you here today?
When did the symptoms begin?
zh: 症状是什么时候开始的？

en: How have the symptoms changed over time?
Where are the symptoms located?
Does the pain radiate elsewhere?
zh: 疼痛是否向其他部位放射？

en: What does the discomfort feel like?
How severe are the symptoms?
How long does each episode last?
How frequently do symptoms occur?
What triggers or worsens the symptoms?
zh: 什么情况会诱发或加重症状？

en: What relieves the symptoms?
What other symptoms have you noticed?
aliases: 请描述这次不适还伴有哪些症状？

en: Which related symptoms are absent?
zh: 有哪些相关症状明确没有出现？

en: Have you had similar episodes before?
zh: 以前是否发生过类似情况？

en: How does this affect daily activities?
zh: 这些症状如何影响日常生活？

en: Have you had fever or chills?
Has your weight changed unexpectedly?
zh: 体重是否有非预期变化？

en: Have you felt unusually tired?
Have you had chest pain?
Have you had difficulty breathing?
Have you had cough or sputum?
Have you had palpitations or fainting?
Have you noticed swelling?
Have you had abdominal pain, vomiting or bowel changes?
zh: 有没有腹痛、呕吐或排便变化？

en: Have you noticed changes in urination?
Have you had weakness, numbness or seizures?
zh: 有没有无力、麻木或抽搐？

en: Have you had headache or dizziness?
Have you noticed vision changes?
Have you noticed hearing changes?
Have you had rashes or skin changes?
zh: 有没有皮疹或皮肤变化？

en: Have you had joint pain or stiffness?
Have you had unusual bleeding or bruising?
zh: 有没有异常出血或瘀青？

en: Have you had increased thirst or urination?
How have your mood and anxiety been?
zh: 最近情绪和焦虑情况如何？

en: Have you had thoughts of harming yourself?
zh: 是否有伤害自己的想法？

en: How have you been sleeping?
What medical conditions have you had?
Have you had surgery or been hospitalized?
zh: 做过什么手术或住过院吗？

en: What medicines and supplements do you take?
zh: 目前在用哪些药物或补充剂？

en: How regularly do you take your medicines?
What treatments have you tried and did they help?
zh: 尝试过哪些治疗，效果如何？

en: Do you have any allergies or adverse drug reactions?
zh: 有什么过敏或药物不良反应？

en: What illnesses run in your family?
Do you smoke or use tobacco?
Do you drink alcohol?
Do you use recreational drugs?
What is your usual diet?
How physically active are you?
What work do you do and what exposures occur?
zh: 从事什么工作，有哪些职业暴露？

en: Have you traveled recently?
Have you had contact with anyone unwell?
Have you had animal or insect exposures?
zh: 有没有动物或昆虫接触史？

en: Have you had chemical or environmental exposures?
zh: 有没有化学品或环境暴露？

en: Could we discuss your sexual health and exposures?
zh: 能否了解您的性健康及相关暴露史？

en: When was your last menstrual period and has it changed?
zh: 末次月经是什么时候，月经有何变化？

en: Is pregnancy possible and what is your pregnancy history?
zh: 是否可能妊娠，既往孕产情况如何？

en: What contraception do you use?
zh: 目前采用什么避孕措施？

en: How has growth and development progressed?
Were there any pregnancy or birth complications?
zh: 孕期和出生时是否有异常？

en: How has feeding and hydration been?
Are vaccinations up to date?
What screening tests have you had?
What support do you have at home?
What are your living conditions?
Are costs or access affecting your care?
zh: 费用或就医条件是否影响治疗？

en: What concerns you most and what are your care goals?
zh: 最担心什么，对治疗有什么期望？

en: Review the recorded clinical history
